name: Fallen City
description: A drowned megacity lit by emergency neon, where the first blackout war began.

name: Ash Meridian
description: Volcanic industrial belts and convoy wars beneath a permanent ash sky.

name: Glass Desert
description: A solar wasteland filled with buried laboratories and mirage storms.

name: Dead Orbit
description: A launch complex where gravity experiments tore open the upper atmosphere.

name: Abyssal Reach
description: Flooded arcologies and ocean-floor reactors hiding the original signal.

name: Winter Crown
description: A frozen capital where a rogue weather engine has become a religion.

name: The Hollow
description: An underground megastructure whose corridors rearrange themselves.

name: Red Garden
description: A biomechanical jungle consuming machines and rewriting DNA.

name: Black Sun
description: A ruined orbital elevator and the first direct war with the machine intelligence.

name: The Choir
description: A city-sized communications cathedral broadcasting a voice from beyond the moon.

name: Eventide
description: A fractured time-zone where future ruins overlap with the present.

name: Last Dawn
description: The shattered sky-core and the final choice that determines what humanity becomes.
